items.title: Perimenopauza je svuda. Kako znati jeste li u njoj?
items.title_en: Perimenopause is everywhere. How do you know if you’re in it?
items.summary: Video Guardiana o perimenopauzi: sve više žena nailazi na pogrešne informacije o liječenju, poput hormonske terapije (HRT). Dr. Paula Briggs, konzultantica za seksualno i reproduktivno zdravlje, objašnjava zašto stručnjaci upozoravaju.
items.summary_en: A Guardian video on perimenopause: a rising number of women meet misinformation about treatments such as HRT. Dr Paula Briggs, a consultant in sexual and reproductive health, explains why experts have raised the alarm.

items.title: Zašto se korijen đumbira mjeri u „palcima“ i centimetrima, a ne u gramima?
items.title_en: Why do recipes measure root ginger in “thumbs” and centimetres rather than weight?
items.summary: Čitatelj pita zašto se svježi đumbir u receptima mjeri u „palcima“ ili centimetrima, a ne u težini. Kuharski tim Guardiana kaže da osobni okus često važi više od stroge preciznosti; Felicity Cloake navodi da vjerojatno nema vrlo dobrog odgovora, nego je to možda samo konvencija.
items.summary_en: A reader asks why recipes give fresh ginger in “thumbs” or centimetres rather than weight. The Guardian food team says personal taste often matters more than strict precision; Felicity Cloake says there is probably no very good answer, perhaps just convention.

items.title: Kostur dinosaura Nanotyrannus „Jodi“ prodan je na aukciji za 47,3 milijuna dolara
items.title_en: The Nanotyrannus skeleton “Jodi” is auctioned for $47.3 million
items.summary: Kostur Nanotyrannusa „Jodi“, srodnika tiranosaurusa rexa, prodan je na aukciji u Sotheby’su za 47,3 milijuna dolara. Prema izvoru, riječ je o najnovijem fosilu dinosaura koji je na privatnoj aukciji postigao visoku cijenu.
items.summary_en: The skeleton of Nanotyrannus “Jodi”, a relative of T. rex, was auctioned at Sotheby’s for $47.3 million. According to the report, it is the latest dinosaur fossil to fetch a high price at a private auction.

items.title: Talijanski poljoprivrednik našao je nepoznato sjeme na tavanu i posadio ga
items.title_en: An Italian farmer found unknown seeds in his attic and planted them
items.summary: Claudio Grossi pronašao je nepoznato sjeme na tavanu i posadio ga. Iz zemlje je izrasla stabljika sa sedam klasova; riječ je o drevnoj žitarici koja, prema izvoru, može odgovoriti na neke moderne probleme.
items.summary_en: Claudio Grossi found unknown seeds in his attic and planted them. A stem with seven ears emerged; the report describes it as an ancient grain that may answer some modern problems.
